+    const int base_rows = world.n_elems_root / comm_size;
+    const int extra_rows = world.n_elems_root % comm_size;
+    for (int rank = 0; rank < comm_size; ++rank) {
+        const int rows = base_rows + (rank < extra_rows ? 1 : 0);
+        const int first_row = rank * base_rows + std::min(rank, extra_rows);
+        counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = rows * world.n_elems_root;
+        displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = first_row * world.n_elems_root;
+    }
+
+    std::vector<double> energy_data;
+    if (comm_rank == 0) {
+        energy_data.resize(n * n);
+    }
+
+    MPI_Datatype owned_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(static_cast<int>(world.owned_elements()), 1,

+                            MPI_DOUBLE, &owned_type);

+
+    const std::size_t first_owned = world.dynamic_offset();

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and

+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+void printGlobalResults(const World& world, MPI_Comm comm) {

+    int comm_rank = 0;

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+void printGlobalResults(const World& world, MPI_Comm comm) {

+    for (int rank = 0; rank < comm_size; ++rank) {

+        const int first_row = rank * base_rows + std::min(rank, extra_rows);
+        counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = rows * world.n_elems_root;
+        displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = first_row * world.n_elems_root;

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+        displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = first_row * world.n_elems_root;

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+void printGlobalResults(const World& world, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    int comm_size = 1;
+    int comm_rank = 0;
+    MPI_Comm_size(comm, &comm_size);
+    MPI_Comm_rank(comm, &comm_rank);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    std::vector<int> counts(static_cast<std::size_t>(comm_size));
+    std::vector<int> displacements(static_cast<std::size_t>(comm_size));
+    const int base_rows = world.n_elems_root / comm_size;
+    const int extra_rows = world.n_elems_root % comm_size;
+    for (int rank = 0; rank < comm_size; ++rank) {
+        const int rows = base_rows + (rank < extra_rows ? 1 : 0);
+        const int first_row = rank * base_rows + std::min(rank, extra_rows);
+        counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = rows * world.n_elems_root;
+        displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = first_row * world.n_elems_root;
+    }
+
+    std::vector<double> energy_data;
+    if (comm_rank == 0) {
+        energy_data.resize(n * n);
+    }
+
+    MPI_Datatype owned_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(static_cast<int>(world.owned_elements()), 1,
+                            static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+                            MPI_DOUBLE, &owned_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&owned_type);
+
+    const std::size_t first_owned = world.dynamic_offset();
+    MPI_Gatherv(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                owned_type,
+                comm_rank == 0 ? energy_data.data() : nullptr,
+                counts.data(), displacements.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, comm);
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&owned_type);
+    if (comm_rank == 0) {
+        print_results(energy_data, "ElementEnergy");
+    }
+}

+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+void printGlobalResults(const World& world, MPI_Comm comm) {

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+void printGlobalResults(const World& world, MPI_Comm comm) {

+        displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = first_row * world.n_elems_root;

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

    73	// Build a 2D square grid as an unstructured mesh
    74	// This represents computation on arbitrarily-shaped geometries
    75	void buildSquare2D(World& world, const int n_elems_root, const int row_begin,
    76	                   const int local_rows, const int mpi_rank,
    77	                   const int mpi_size) {
    78	    world.n_elems_root = n_elems_root;
    79	    world.row_begin = row_begin;
    80	    world.local_rows = local_rows;
    81	    world.mpi_rank = mpi_rank;
    82	    world.mpi_size = mpi_size;
    83	
    84	    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(n_elems_root);
    85	    const std::size_t n_elems =
    86	        static_cast<std::size_t>(local_rows) * n;
    87	    const std::size_t dynamic_elems = n_elems + 2 * n;
    88	    
    89	    // Initialize materials
    90	    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, 0.0});    // Default material
    91	    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, 0.5});    // Inflow material
    92	    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, -0.5});   // Outflow material
    93	    
    94	    // Allocate elements
    95	    world.elements_static.resize(n_elems);
    96	    world.elements_dynamic.resize(dynamic_elems);
    97	    world.elements_dynamic_swap.resize(dynamic_elems);
    98	    
    99	    // Initialize all elements with default material and zero energy
   100	    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n_elems; ++i) {
   101	        world.elements_static[i].material_idx = DEFAULT_MAT_ID;
   102	        world.elements_static[i].num_connections = 0;
   103	        world.elements_dynamic[i].current_energy = 0.0;
   104	        world.elements_dynamic[i].total_flux = 0.0;
   105	    }
   106	    for (std::size_t i = n_elems; i < dynamic_elems; ++i) {
   107	        world.elements_dynamic[i].current_energy = 0.0;
   108	        world.elements_dynamic[i].total_flux = 0.0;
   109	    }
   110	    std::fill(world.elements_dynamic_swap.begin(),
   111	              world.elements_dynamic_swap.end(), ElementDynamic{0.0, 0.0});
   112	    
   113	    // Build connectivity: each element connects to its neighbors in 2D grid
   114	    const int row_end = row_begin + local_rows;
   115	    for (int local_x = 0; local_x < local_rows; ++local_x) {
   116	        const int x = row_begin + local_x;
   117	        for (int y = 0; y < n_elems_root; ++y) {
   118	            const std::size_t idx = static_cast<std::size_t>(local_x) * n +
   119	                                    static_cast<std::size_t>(y);
   120	            ElementStatic& elem = world.elements_static[idx];
   121	            
   122	            // Connect to neighbors (up, down, left, right)
   123	            const int offsets[4][2] = {{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}};
   124	            
   125	            for (int direction = 0; direction < 4; ++direction) {
   126	                const int nx = x + offsets[direction][0];
   127	                const int ny = y + offsets[direction][1];
   128	                
   129	                // Check if neighbor is within bounds
   130	                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n_elems_root && ny >= 0 && ny < n_elems_root) {
   131	                    std::size_t neighbor_idx;
   132	                    if (nx < row_begin) {
   133	                        neighbor_idx = static_cast<std::size_t>(ny);
   134	                    } else if (nx >= row_end) {
   135	                        neighbor_idx = static_cast<std::size_t>(local_rows + 1) * n +
   136	                                       static_cast<std::size_t>(ny);
   137	                    } else {
   138	                        neighbor_idx = static_cast<std::size_t>(nx - row_begin + 1) * n +
   139	                                       static_cast<std::size_t>(ny);
   140	                    }
   141	                    elem.connected_idx[elem.num_connections] = neighbor_idx;
   142	                    elem.connected_flux[elem.num_connections] = 1.0;
   143	                    elem.num_connections++;
   144	                }
   145	            }
   146	        }
   147	    }
   148	    
   149	    // Set corner elements as inflow/outflow to create interesting dynamics
   150	    const int last = n_elems_root - 1;
   151	    if (row_begin <= 0 && 0 < row_end) {
   152	        world.elements_static[0].material_idx = INFLOW_MAT_ID;
   153	        world.elements_static[static_cast<std::size_t>(last)].material_idx =
   154	            OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;
   155	    }
   156	    if (row_begin <= last && last < row_end) {
   157	        const std::size_t last_row = static_cast<std::size_t>(local_rows - 1) * n;
   158	        world.elements_static[last_row].material_idx = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;
   159	        world.elements_static[last_row + static_cast<std::size_t>(last)].material_idx =
   160	            INFLOW_MAT_ID;
   161	    }
   162	}

   164	// Compute energy flux between two elements
   165	inline val_t computeFlux(const Material& mat, const ElementDynamic& this_elem,
   166	                        val_t connection_flux, const ElementDynamic& other_elem) {
   167	    return (other_elem.current_energy - this_elem.current_energy) * 
   168	           mat.transfer_coeff * connection_flux * 0.25;
   169	}
   170	
   171	inline void updateRows(World& world, const int first_row, const int last_row) {
   172	    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
   173	    const std::size_t dynamic_offset = world.dynamic_offset();
   174	
   175	    for (int local_row = first_row; local_row < last_row; ++local_row) {
   176	        const std::size_t static_base = static_cast<std::size_t>(local_row) * n;
   177	        const std::size_t dynamic_base = static_base + dynamic_offset;
   178	        for (std::size_t y = 0; y < n; ++y) {
   179	            const ElementStatic& elem_static = world.elements_static[static_base + y];
   180	            const ElementDynamic& elem_dyn =
   181	                world.elements_dynamic[dynamic_base + y];
   182	            const Material& mat = world.materials[elem_static.material_idx];
   183	
   184	            val_t total_flux = mat.external_flow;
   185	            for (idx_t j = 0; j < elem_static.num_connections; ++j) {
   186	                const idx_t neighbor_idx = elem_static.connected_idx[j];
   187	                const ElementDynamic& neighbor_dyn =
   188	                    world.elements_dynamic[neighbor_idx];
   189	                total_flux += computeFlux(mat, elem_dyn,
   190	                                          elem_static.connected_flux[j],
   191	                                          neighbor_dyn);
   192	            }
   193	
   194	            ElementDynamic& elem_write =
   195	                world.elements_dynamic_swap[dynamic_base + y];
   196	            elem_write.current_energy = elem_dyn.current_energy + total_flux;
   197	            elem_write.total_flux = elem_dyn.total_flux + std::abs(total_flux);
   198	        }
   199	    }
   200	}
   201	
   202	// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
   203	// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
   204	void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
   205	    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
   206	    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
   207	        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
   208	        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
   209	    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
   210	
   211	    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
   212	    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
   213	        MPI_Request requests[4];
   214	        int request_count = 0;
   215	
   216	        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
   217	        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
   218	        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
   219	            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
   220	                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
   221	                      &requests[request_count++]);
   222	        }
   223	        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
   224	            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
   225	                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
   226	            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
   227	                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
   228	                      &requests[request_count++]);
   229	        }
   230	
   231	        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
   232	            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
   233	            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
   234	                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
   235	                      &requests[request_count++]);
   236	        }
   237	        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
   238	            const std::size_t last_owned =
   239	                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
   240	            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
   241	                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
   242	                      &requests[request_count++]);
   243	        }
   244	
   245	        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
   246	        // the boundary exchange progresses.
   247	        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
   248	            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
   249	        }
   250	
   251	        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
   252	        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
   253	        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
   254	            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
   255	        }
   256	
   257	        std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
   258	    }
   259	
   260	    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
   261	}
