   263	// Validate simulation results. Reductions avoid gathering the full state for
   264	// the normal validation path; -r gathers only when globally ordered samples
   265	// are explicitly requested.
   266	bool validateResults(const World& world, MPI_Comm comm) {
   267	    val_t energy_sum = 0.0;
   268	    val_t flux_sum = 0.0;
   269	    val_t energy_max = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();
   270	    val_t energy_min = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();
   271	
   272	    const std::size_t dynamic_offset = world.dynamic_offset();
   273	    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < world.owned_elements(); ++i) {
   274	        const ElementDynamic& elem = world.elements_dynamic[dynamic_offset + i];
   275	        energy_sum += elem.current_energy;
   276	        flux_sum += elem.total_flux;
   277	        energy_max = std::max(elem.current_energy, energy_max);
   278	        energy_min = std::min(elem.current_energy, energy_min);
   279	    }
   280	
   281	    val_t global_energy_sum = 0.0;
   282	    val_t global_flux_sum = 0.0;
   283	    val_t global_energy_max = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();
   284	    val_t global_energy_min = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();
   285	    MPI_Reduce(&energy_sum, &global_energy_sum, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0, comm);
   286	    MPI_Reduce(&flux_sum, &global_flux_sum, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0, comm);
   287	    MPI_Reduce(&energy_max, &global_energy_max, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, comm);
   288	    MPI_Reduce(&energy_min, &global_energy_min, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN, 0, comm);
   289	
   290	    int local_finite = 1;
   291	    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < world.owned_elements(); ++i) {
   292	        const ElementDynamic& elem = world.elements_dynamic[dynamic_offset + i];
   293	        if (!std::isfinite(elem.current_energy) ||
   294	            !std::isfinite(elem.total_flux)) {
   295	            local_finite = 0;
   296	            break;
   297	        }
   298	    }
   299	    int all_finite = 0;
   300	    MPI_Reduce(&local_finite, &all_finite, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MIN, 0, comm);
   301	
   302	    int valid = 1;
   303	    int rank = 0;
   304	    MPI_Comm_rank(comm, &rank);
   305	    if (rank == 0) {
   306	        printf("Validation results:\n");
   307	        printf("  Energy sum: %.12f\n", global_energy_sum);
   308	        printf("  Flux sum: %.2f\n", global_flux_sum);
   309	        printf("  Energy range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", global_energy_min,
   310	               global_energy_max);
   311	
   312	    // Check for numerical issues
   313	    constexpr val_t energy_epsilon = 1e-8;
   314	
   315	        if (!all_finite || !std::isfinite(global_energy_sum)) {
   316	            printf("  ERROR: Energy sum is not finite\n");
   317	            valid = 0;
   318	        } else if (std::abs(global_energy_sum) > energy_epsilon) {
   319	            printf("  WARNING: Energy sum diverged from 0 (expected conservation)\n");
   320	            // Don't fail validation as this can happen with external flows
   321	        }
   322	
   323	        if (!std::isfinite(global_flux_sum)) {
   324	            printf("  ERROR: Flux sum is not finite\n");
   325	            valid = 0;
   326	        }
   327	
   328	        if (!std::isfinite(global_energy_max) ||
   329	            !std::isfinite(global_energy_min)) {
   330	            printf("  ERROR: Energy extrema are not finite\n");
   331	            valid = 0;
   332	        }
   333	
   334	        if (valid) {
   335	            printf("  Validation: PASSED\n");
   336	        }
   337	    }
   338	
   339	    MPI_Bcast(&valid, 1, MPI_INT, 0, comm);
   340	    return valid != 0;
   341	}

   343	// Compute a simple hash of the results for verification
   344	uint64_t computeLocalHash(const World& world) {
   345	    uint64_t hash = 0;
   346	    const std::size_t dynamic_offset = world.dynamic_offset();
   347	    const std::size_t global_offset =
   348	        static_cast<std::size_t>(world.row_begin) *
   349	        static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
   350	    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < world.owned_elements(); ++i) {
   351	        // Simple hash combining energy and flux values
   352	        uint64_t energy_bits = 0;
   353	        uint64_t flux_bits = 0;
   354	        std::memcpy(&energy_bits,
   355	                    &world.elements_dynamic[dynamic_offset + i].current_energy,
   356	                    sizeof(energy_bits));
   357	        std::memcpy(&flux_bits,
   358	                    &world.elements_dynamic[dynamic_offset + i].total_flux,
   359	                    sizeof(flux_bits));
   360	        const uint64_t global_i = static_cast<uint64_t>(global_offset + i);
   361	        hash ^= (energy_bits + global_i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
   362	        hash ^= (flux_bits + global_i) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
   363	    }
   364	    return hash;
   365	}

   367	void printGlobalResults(const World& world, MPI_Comm comm) {
   368	    int comm_size = 1;
   369	    int comm_rank = 0;
   370	    MPI_Comm_size(comm, &comm_size);
   371	    MPI_Comm_rank(comm, &comm_rank);
   372	
   373	    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
   374	    std::vector<int> counts(static_cast<std::size_t>(comm_size));
   375	    std::vector<int> displacements(static_cast<std::size_t>(comm_size));
   376	    const int base_rows = world.n_elems_root / comm_size;
   377	    const int extra_rows = world.n_elems_root % comm_size;
   378	    for (int rank = 0; rank < comm_size; ++rank) {
   379	        const int rows = base_rows + (rank < extra_rows ? 1 : 0);
   380	        const int first_row = rank * base_rows + std::min(rank, extra_rows);
   381	        counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = rows * world.n_elems_root;
   382	        displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = first_row * world.n_elems_root;
   383	    }
   384	
   385	    std::vector<double> energy_data;
   386	    if (comm_rank == 0) {
   387	        energy_data.resize(n * n);
   388	    }
   389	
   390	    MPI_Datatype owned_type;
   391	    MPI_Type_create_hvector(static_cast<int>(world.owned_elements()), 1,
   392	                            static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
   393	                            MPI_DOUBLE, &owned_type);
   394	    MPI_Type_commit(&owned_type);
   395	
   396	    const std::size_t first_owned = world.dynamic_offset();
   397	    MPI_Gatherv(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
   398	                owned_type,
   399	                comm_rank == 0 ? energy_data.data() : nullptr,
   400	                counts.data(), displacements.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, comm);
   401	
   402	    MPI_Type_free(&owned_type);
   403	    if (comm_rank == 0) {
   404	        print_results(energy_data, "ElementEnergy");
   405	    }
   406	}

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+void printGlobalResults(const World& world, MPI_Comm comm) {

+        counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = rows * world.n_elems_root;
+        displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = first_row * world.n_elems_root;

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

+void printGlobalResults(const World& world, MPI_Comm comm) {

+    const int base_rows = world.n_elems_root / comm_size;
+    const int extra_rows = world.n_elems_root % comm_size;

+        const int rows = base_rows + (rank < extra_rows ? 1 : 0);
+        const int first_row = rank * base_rows + std::min(rank, extra_rows);
+        counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = rows * world.n_elems_root;
+        displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(rank)] = first_row * world.n_elems_root;
+    }
+
+    std::vector<double> energy_data;
+    if (comm_rank == 0) {
+        energy_data.resize(n * n);
+    }
+
+    MPI_Datatype owned_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(static_cast<int>(world.owned_elements()), 1,
+                            static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+                            MPI_DOUBLE, &owned_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&owned_type);
+
+    const std::size_t first_owned = world.dynamic_offset();
+    MPI_Gatherv(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                owned_type,
+                comm_rank == 0 ? energy_data.data() : nullptr,
+                counts.data(), displacements.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, comm);
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&owned_type);
+    if (comm_rank == 0) {

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }

Implemented MPI distributed-memory parallelization in:

- [unstructured.cpp](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/unstructured_gpt-5.6-luna-xhigh_mpi_r2/unstructured/unstructured.cpp)
- [CMakeLists.txt](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/unstructured_gpt-5.6-luna-xhigh_mpi_r2/unstructured/CMakeLists.txt)

Key points:

- 1D row decomposition with nonblocking halo exchange.
- Interior computation overlaps MPI communication.
- Distributed validation, hashing, timing, and ordered `-r` gathering.
- Executable remains `unstructured`.
- MPI is required and used unconditionally.
- No new repository files or external dependencies added.

Verified with CMake builds and MPI runs using 1, 2, 4, 7, and oversubscribed ranks; distributed hashes and results matched single-rank output exactly.

+// Run simulation for n_iters iterations. Each rank owns a group of rows and
+// exchanges only the two boundary rows needed by the unstructured connectivity.
+void runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    MPI_Datatype halo_row_type;
+    MPI_Type_create_hvector(
+        world.n_elems_root, 1, static_cast<MPI_Aint>(sizeof(ElementDynamic)),
+        MPI_DOUBLE, &halo_row_type);
+    MPI_Type_commit(&halo_row_type);
+
+    const std::size_t n = static_cast<std::size_t>(world.n_elems_root);
+    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        // The first rank receives a top halo from its predecessor; the last
+        // rank receives a bottom halo from its successor.
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[0].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t bottom_halo =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows + 1) * n;
+            MPI_Irecv(&world.elements_dynamic[bottom_halo].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        if (world.mpi_rank > 0) {
+            const std::size_t first_owned = n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[first_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank - 1, 1, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+        if (world.mpi_rank + 1 < world.mpi_size) {
+            const std::size_t last_owned =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(world.local_rows) * n;
+            MPI_Isend(&world.elements_dynamic[last_owned].current_energy, 1,
+                      halo_row_type, world.mpi_rank + 1, 0, comm,
+                      &requests[request_count++]);
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows have no remote dependencies and can be computed while
+        // the boundary exchange progresses.
+        if (world.local_rows > 2) {
+            updateRows(world, 1, world.local_rows - 1);
+        }
+
+        MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+        updateRows(world, 0, std::min(world.local_rows, 1));
+        if (world.local_rows > 1) {
+            updateRows(world, world.local_rows - 1, world.local_rows);
+        }
+
         std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);
     }
+
+    MPI_Type_free(&halo_row_type);
 }
